name: White Gut & White Feces Syndrome (WGS/WFS)
clinical_signs: White fecal strings, empty gut, soft shell, growth stunting
trigger_water_parameters: TAN > 0.5 ppm, Nitrite > 0.3 ppm, High sludge
manufacturer_location: New Autonagar, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India
active_consortium: Citrobacter freundii, Bacillus subtilis, Lactobacillus, Yeast

name: Toxic Total Ammonia Nitrogen (TAN) & Nitrite (NO2) Toxicosis
scientific_pathogen: Abiotic autotrophic nitrification failure; un-ionized NH3/NO2-
clinical_signs: Surface gasping, gill necrosis, red pleopods, sudden mortality
trigger_water_parameters: TAN > 1.0 ppm, NO2 > 0.5 ppm, pH > 8.3, DO < 4.0 ppm
manufacturer_location: New Autonagar, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India

manufacturer_location: New Autonagar, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India

name: White Muscle Disease & Idiopathic Muscle Necrosis (IMN)
